runtimeErrorCheck.diagnostics: Vercel CLI query within Hobby retention returned four safe timeout logs: health request wjs8m-1793938374507-5e08b10d31af at 04:13, room-create requests mzxsc-1793938506432-fb6abcb613a7 at 04:15 and w9ws4-1793938679837-28741046ccf7 at 04:18, and health request plkpd-1793938936883-7d13ae2d9d57 at 04:22. The room-create logs classify query-read-timeout at gameRoom.create (~20 seconds); health logs classify the same query timeout. Pool snapshots show total/idle/waiting=0. The fresh canonical health probe at 04:25 returned 200. Vercel documents the runtime-log Region field as the edge region that processed the request; x-vercel-id headers include iad1 and the deployment function is configured in iad1, consistent with the us-east-1 database placement. The London edge region does not indicate London function compute.

database.pollingEstimate: Source-traced 2026-11-05: each successful PrismaRoomStore.getRoom call performs one Prisma Client participant.findFirst with relationLoadStrategy=join. Prisma counts each Prisma Client query as one operation regardless of internal SQL count. At the configured 30-second interval this is 172,800 room-poll operations/month for two continuously open tabs and 345,600 for four. A two-hour guest match uses about 480 room-poll operations for two players or 960 for four, before setup/actions/reconnects. Each visible signed-in account with presence opted in sends one heartbeat every 30 seconds; each calls one updateMany, adding about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session.
database.note: Owner approved dedicated Production database on Prisma Free ($0, fixed 200,000-operation shared workspace cap; no paid upgrade or overages). Direct Console plan and $0 invoice were last confirmed 5 November; current billing cannot be refreshed through CLI. At 05:34 UTC Prisma CLI measured 8,618 Production operations. The sum across all nine databases in all five enumerated projects is 34,369 at 05:34 UTC, a derived estimate rather than the direct Console workspace meter. The Production backup inventory at 05:18 UTC showed no listed backups (zero retention). Production database is ready and lists five credential records, but per-credential health is unavailable. One manual dump/restore drill passed once; Free has no automatic backups, and recurring backup/restore ownership and cadence remain open.
